data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (timeanddate time lookup, weather.com 10-day forecast for {day}, then a mail draft with the correct To, Subject and Body that is discarded) and names city, relative and day as parameters, but it adds an unneeded 'recipient' parameter even though the steps hardcode family@example.com, and its note 'save or send in a real run' muddies the instruction not to send.
